messages.subject: Harmony Gold | Stakeholder relations, corporate affairs and responsible-mining execution
messages.body:
Dear Dr. Mashego,

Your remit across Stakeholder Relations and Corporate Affairs at Harmony Gold is closely aligned with the operating interface I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, community engagement, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major mining operation. I routinely translate external expectations into accountable action across operations, environment, HSE, legal, HR, finance, procurement and technical teams.

I would value a senior conversation about where this experience might support Harmony's stakeholder-relations, corporate-affairs, social-performance or country-facing leadership priorities. I also bring direct experience around industrial renewable-energy stakeholder governance and carbon-accounting evidence.

My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Harmony Gold and the responsibilities within your portfolio.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
